notes.title: A critical bug has been fixed.
notes.notes:
We have fixed critical bugs such as being unable to remove equipment.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Magic stones are now easier to obtain:
notes.notes:
Now drop from regular monsters as well
Drop amount increased threefold

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
・Fixed a bug where the game would not progress after using certain skills.
・Fixed a bug where some weapons could not be equipped.
・Fixed a bug where magic enhancement skills were not working correctly.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that occurred when using a chanting skill.

notes.title: Small adjustment
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where input was not recognized with certain controllers.[/p][p]Fixed missing translations in some languages.[/p]

notes.title: Small adjustment
notes.notes: We’ve made adjustments to the user interface and fixed several input-related issues.
